Welfare Paradox: The experiment intentionally induces failure to measure instability. The act of measurement may constitute the very welfare-negative condition the team seeks to monitor. Mitigation: Keep conditions brief; use the data to advocate for improved stopping conditions / circuit breakers in production systems.
